opening_question: Namaste. Saans ki takleef ke baare mein bataiye — kab se ho rahi hai?

mandatory_slots.question: Saans ki takleef kab se hai — achanak shuru hui ya dheere-dheere badhi?
1 se 10 ke beech, saans lene mein kitni takleef hai?
Kis cheez se takleef badhti hai — chalne se, letne se, ya aaram karne par bhi rehti hai?
Kya aaram karte waqt bhi saans phoolti hai?

screening_questions.question: Saans lene ke saath seene mein dard bhi hota hai?
Honth ya ungliyaan neeli ya pili padte dikhe hain?
Saans lete waqt seeti jaisi awaaz (wheezing) aati hai?

background_slots.question: Pehle kabhi asthma, COPD, ya heart ki koi bimari hui hai?
Koi inhaler ya dawai chal rahi hai?
